note: Marion County park on Marion County Lake SE of Marion (not the Corps' Marion Reservoir): year-round electric and water RV sites in the west-shore campground, primitive camping along the lakeshore, shower house, lake hall, heated fishing dock, swim beach, disc golf. --Claude
summary: Confirmed year-round RV hookups (electric and water) and showers; website moved to the county's /375/Park-Lake page. No rate written: the county's posted sheet is from 2021 ($14 a night non-resident E&W), and a 2023 increase was proposed. The stored inclusion evidence describes an Iowa park. Waterfront lead lakefront -> lakeview. Pin move ~240 m.
flags: INCLUSION EVIDENCE IS FOR THE WRONG PARK: the stored inclusion_evidence ('mycountyparks.com Marion County Park: 99 sites, gravel/cement pads with 50A electric+water(+sewer) hookups') is Marion County Park in Knoxville, Iowa (mycountyparks page says 'Marion County, IA', 306 Willetts Drive, 641-828-2214). Replace it with the Kansas county's own page: https://www.marioncoks.net/375/Park-Lake ('Year-Round RV Hookups', 'Camping Grounds') plus the rate sheet's 'Electric & Water Camping'. It is still a real county RV campground (RVs on sites in imagery; Google 4.7 over 195 reviews). No site count, amperage or sewer is published for the Kansas park, so don't carry over the Iowa park's 99 sites or 50 A.
Website: replace https://www.marioncoks.net/park-lake (404) with https://www.marioncoks.net/375/Park-Lake. apply.py does not write websites. Phone 620-382-3240 confirmed.

FEES not written: the county's only posted rate sheet (https://www.marioncoks.net/376/Marion-County-Lake-Price-Rates, PDF created 2021-03-22) gives $13 county / $14 non-county a night for electric and water, $7/$8 tent. The Marion County Record (2023-03-09) reported proposals to raise RV spots to $15/$16-18. Current rate unconfirmed; a call to 620-382-3240 would settle it. Either figure is far under the gate.

WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview. The stored evidence point 38.3158,-96.9923 is in the water by the dam, and its 'row of angled RV pads on the shoreline' was not found. In imagery the RVs on hookup sites sit in the west-shore campground 40-80 m from the water across open grass, with fishing docks and shoreline day use along the bank between them and the lake: no on-water by the AWH 2026-11-01 rulings, but a clear view. The SE shore carries primitive pull-offs along a shoreline road (road between for most), at best lakeview. Downgrade per the unsure rule.
PIN MOVE (~240 m): the stored 38.31907,-96.99451 is in a field west of the county road. Move it to the west-shore camping loop at 38.3172,-96.9931.

LONG-STAY watch: the park sells an annual camping permit ($100 county / $125 non-county, then $6-7 a night with it) and $15/month RV storage. Imagery shows ~55 trailers packed in rows along the west road and in three rows at the north end, which are storage or seasonal units. Nightly E&W camping is sold, so it passes, but the transient share is unknown. No sand issue.
